BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Sapphire Roga!!
Welcome to Avant Plastida...
Whoa! What's that thing?! Looks like a defective\npuppet. So creepy!!
You guys seem to think that this is our nest, but\nyou guys are wrong. It's a colony we formed\ntogether, in short, it's our body.
In other words, you have voluntarily dived into\nour body...
"We" you said? I see...the Coenubia colony that\nforms this place shares common thoughts and\ncommunicates through this creature...
Hey, why are you occupying Eldenbaum?!
Who in the world is stupid enough to expose their\nown plan to low-class creatures that are their\nenemies?!
Did you just say "low-class creatures"?!\nGrrrr, that's so annoying...Look at yourself in\nthe mirror! Now tell us who's low-class here!!
S-so this is Coenubia's true form!!
Hey, low-class creatures! You'd better stop\nwasting your energy and just let us absorb you as\nour nutrition to proliferate!!
Oh my gawd! What the heck, that's dangerous, you\nknow! Stop talking through the back of your head!!
T-though it's only rolling, it's pretty strong!
Oh yeah, water! Water! They're weak to water!\nUse water magic!!
What?!
How cruel! Using its fellow Coenubia crystal\nmonsters as a shield is just...
Unlike us, it's not a human!\nOf course it doesn't think like us!!\nCome over here!
Nooooooo!!
W-we're...just...the front line guard...\nY-you'll...r-regret it w-when...you know...\nC-Coenubia's true power...
Yesss! We beat Coenubia!\nYay!!
There must still be countless Coenubias inside\nEldenbaum...
The front line guard is already this big...\nWhat about the one occupying the center of\nEldenbaum...I can't even imagine...
True. Anyway, we beat nearby foes. Let's tighten\nfront line base security until reinforcements\narrive. Let's head back to Dikkit Sector!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing! Let's get out!
